Multipart upload of one already-encrypted file (any bytes, limited by
the server's maximum upload size). Stored verbatim as
`/uploads/<uuid>.bin` with no decoding, thumbnail or other
processing. Usable only as the `attachmentUrl` of an encrypted
(`v1`) direct message; the same message claims it for the
conversation.
